_doc: Spec 016 storage ratchet (env freeze ratchet, 2026-10-11 decision), enforced by scripts/snap-split/verify.py step 8 (Ratchet).
Every value must equal what verify.py measures at the PR head; the copy at the merge-base with staging is the ceiling.
Lower a value (remove a per-file entry at 0) in the PR that reduces it. env.members, env.header, env.storage_members and raw_imports never go up.
Per-file counts may move between files while storage_refs_total does not rise; a higher total needs a new justifications["storage_refs.total"] line.
Measured set (keys relative to snap/): every .scala file under controller/ and actors/, plus SNAPSyncController.scala, the split's move source (RATCHET_FILES, T054c).

capabilities (T054b; first entry at T055): {TraitName: {file, members, raw_imports}}. Added only by a `# capability: TraitName` PR; never removed. members only goes down (growth needs justifications["capabilities.TraitName.members"]); raw_imports is fixed when the capability is introduced and only shrinks. The capability file is the storage boundary, so it is not a storage_refs row; elsewhere `accessor.call` is not a storage reference, while `accessor.handle` (a parameterless storage-typed member) counts once.

counter (T060b): the counter version (verify.py COUNTER_VERSIONS; absent = 1). Version 2 drops the coordinators' reviewed false positives (STORAGE_NAME_ALLOW_V2) and counts `storageDone`. It only goes up, and raising it re-baselines every row, so it needs a new justifications["storage_refs.total"] line.

justifications.storage_refs.total: CQ-020-07 (SNAP pivot body stored without its withdrawals, #1652), 544 -> 549 (+5): a rise, needed to stop finalization overwriting the pivot body. controller/SnapFinalization.scala 34 -> 39: the single stateIngest.chainWriter.storeBlock(Block(pivotHeader, BlockBody.empty)) write (which overwrote a body a newPayload had already stored, losing Ephemery 137594's 16 withdrawals) becomes stateIngest.chainWriter.storeBlockHeader (header + number->hash mapping only) plus applyPivotBodyCheck's stateIngest.chainReader.getBlockBodyByHash read and its two conditional writes, stateIngest.chainWriter.storeCheckedBlockBody (Write: body derived from a header that commits to an empty body, or a contradicting one replaced) and stateIngest.chainWriter.removeBlockBody (Remove: let the backfill refetch it), each counted once. No store is added to StateIngest or any Env; every reference goes through the existing chainWriter/chainReader members.

justifications.capabilities.StateIngest.members: spec 016 C-H1 (D-T060-1 route (a), user decision 2026-10-12, healing stores decided at C-H1, #1584): 12 -> 14. StateIngest gains the healing stores TrieNodeHealingCoordinator takes: healingFrontier (Option[HealingFrontierStorage], HealingOrchestrator's healingFrontierStorageOpt: Some only with frontier persistence or pruned heal verification) and bfsQueue (Option[BfsQueueStorage], HealingOrchestrator's bfsQueueStorageOpt, always Some). Both are by-name apply parameters fed by those lazy vals, so building the capability builds neither and each read returns the one instance, built on the first read (the healing spawn), as before. Recovery's mirrored capability hands out None for both. Previous line (T060d): spec 016 T060d (D-T060-1, user decision 2026-10-12): 9 -> 12. StateIngest gains the derived stores the coordinators take: trieStore(pivot) (a pure forwarder of stateStorage.getBackingStorage, called only by the core's per-pivot cache getOrCreateMptStorage), snapProgress (the core's snapProgressStorage) and storageDone (the core's storageDoneStorage, by-name because the core builds it after the capability). Same instances, built where they are today. The healing stores (HealingFrontierStorage, BfsQueueStorage) are deferred to C-H1 (#1584)
